experienceSection.description: We believe every professional deserves the chance to grow without giving up their main career. Through flexible programs and expert mentorship, Kesatria Academy helps you master essential IT skills and get to compete in the global tech industry.

imagine.description: Imagine joining a 3-month intensive journey where you learn directly from industry experts, work on real-world projects, and build a professional portfolio that opens doors to your dream career in tech.
imagine.spanMostWanted: This is the most desired benefit by most learners.

alumniSection.description: Every alumnus has their own unique journey — from the first step of learning, facing challenges, to finally building a successful career in tech. Hear how their experience with Kesatria Academy opened new opportunities and transformed their future.
